description: single-blink: A single flash, repeated. Use 'blink_hz' for how often and 'on_ms' for how long each flash lasts.

rf_stacks.description: Radio stack versions this firmware supports. Chosen per profile; recorded, not yet sent to the node.

config.set.description: Change the node's settings. Only the settings you include are changed; everything else keeps its current value. Changes apply immediately and survive reboots. The 'led' settings belong to the app.

update_interval_ms.description: How often the node takes a new reading (temperature, counter) and puts it in its advert. Shorter = fresher data on the dashboard; longer = less radio activity.

adv_interval_ms.description: How often the node broadcasts its advert. Shorter makes it easier for the scanner to catch every reading (and quicker to find for deploys); longer saves power.

on_ms.description: Length of each flash (kept shorter than the period)

led.description: The LED pattern that identifies this app.

config.reset.description: Put every setting back to this app's factory defaults.

device.identify.description: Flash the LED rapidly for a while so you can tell which physical board this is.

device.reboot.description: Restart the node. The deploy waits for it to come back before running the next call.

board.set_id.description: Set this node's board number, which names it (hs-<id>) in adverts, readings and the fleet. Per-device, so it can't go in a shared config: use 'Set board ID on deploy' instead.

id.description: Board number, 0-255; shown as hs-01, hs-02, ...

device.info.description: Device ID, BLE address, app, firmware, partition, board ID, family.

readings.read.description: Buffered readings for the phone gateway (last hour), oldest first, paged.
